summary: Verified 7.0/10, NOT on par (no blocker, score under 7.5). Both majors reproduce from the cited artifacts. In the RIFT crops (closing_ilsheta2_self_z285_crop.png, ally_z285_crop.png) the chimney reads only as a faint outlined glass tube with a rim ellipse over a grey-white bell, and the body has no hue of its own. The splash problem is plain at 1x: three splashes in the same standing lamp pose, the figure in the right third, a smear filter, and base and First Bell using the identical spire/bridge/chasm plate with a sepia regrade. All minors check out: turntable cells 9-10 show the lamp over the face in run; cells 4-5 show the smooth back shell; fw_CW6_m_lineup.json gives ilsheta facing 180 accentPct 0.52, facing 0 accentTopHalfShare 0.371, accentOk false and valueGradientOk false. closing_ilsheta2_clips.txt matches the claims (idle x_lamp 21.77, recall 6.0 s with hand.L 143), and actors.ts:1097-1098 confirms the recall clip is stretched over the channel. The GLB's last content commit is 89112e613 (the GF-1 revert). Sensitivity is clean: the hood is rounded at every turntable cell, the chimney is a flat-topped glass cylinder, and the face has brows, a nose, a mouth and amber eyes with pupils, so it reads as porcelain, not horror or a mannequin. Watch item: at 1x on the base splash the white oval plate with small amber eyes leans doll-like, but it stays under blocker class. Leftover 3 is downgraded to partly because the enemy-view frame is unusable (fog).

findings.title: The signature chimney reads only as a faint outlined tube and rim at the gameplay camera, and the body is a hue-less pale bell
findings.what: At RIFT zoom the glass chimney is see-through over lane stone. Only the rim ellipse and faint side edges show, and there is no forward spout. The body is grey-white, and the only colour is the team-tinted lamp.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_ilsheta2_self_z285_crop.png and closing_ilsheta2_ally_z285_crop.png (viewed by the verifier). The GLB is unchanged since the 89112e613 GF-1 revert. _design/fighters/ilsheta.md §1 calls for the brightest vertical.
findings.gauge: LoL: the signature shape and hue read from the top-down silhouette in a crowded fight. VALE: the defining shape is near-invisible, and what remains is a value-only bell.
findings.fix: Give the game-LOD chimney an inner pale dawnglass shell (about 0.55 opacity), a 2-3 cm opaque chalk band and a wider forward spout. Optionally add a faint low #74B300 wick tint (non-emissive). Re-gate with lineup_qa top-down masks.
findings.verifierNote: Partly refuted: the tube is not wholly invisible, because its outline does show in the self crop. But it is far from the brightest vertical, and the monochrome body holds. The severity stays major because the brief's own signature read fails.

findings.title: Three splashes are one standing hold-the-lamp pose on a filtered matte, and base and First Bell share the same plate
findings.what: In all three splashes she stands frontal in the right third with the lamp held out. There is no action beat, no shared light or contact interaction with the plate, and the smear filter posterises the figure. First Bell is the base's spire, bridge and chasm plate regraded to sepia.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/ilsheta/splash.png, ilsheta_first_bell_splash.png and ilsheta_stillwater_splash.png at 1x: the spire and bridge layout is identical in base and First Bell. _harness/_shots/closing_ilsheta2_splash_face.png shows the posterised blocks.
findings.gauge: LoL: each splash is a unique illustration with an action pose, integrated light and a skin-specific setting. VALE: one pose, and the deluxe skin reuses the base plate.
findings.fix: Stage VALE-own beats: base, the Hung Lamp release lighting an ally; First Bell, ringing the lamp's small bell at a dawn bell-tower; Stillwater, wading at a tide line with the lamp's reflection. Use a unique plate per skin, a lamp as a local light, a contact shadow, and the filter on the backdrop only.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced at 1x. The Stillwater plate is distinct, but its pose is the same family. Major is right: this is presentation, not a blocker.

findings.title: Dark stepped blocks along the face plate's edge in the cards
findings.what: A stepped projection seam remains where the plate meets the hood lining.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_ilsheta2_portrait_face.png (right cheek) and closing_ilsheta2_splash_face.png (right edge of the plate).
findings.gauge: LoL faces read clean at splash and select scale.
findings.fix: Bake a painted radial AO ramp in the face patch's UV, and erode the alpha by 2-3 texels.

findings.title: In run poses the lamp cage sits in front of the face
findings.what: In run_fwd both hands hold the lamp at chest and face height.
findings.gauge: LoL locomotion keeps the face and the key prop separate in silhouette.
findings.fix: Carry the lamp low at the right hip on the staff, with the free hand swinging.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed. At the top-down gameplay camera the face is rarely visible, so it stays minor.

findings.title: Crook-shaped hook, smooth back shell, small idle
findings.what: The back is a smooth bell with no fold read, the hook is a round crook, and the idle head barely moves.
findings.evidence: turntable.png cells 4-5 and cell 1. closing_ilsheta2_clips.txt idle row (head is not in the top 8).
findings.gauge: LoL models carry readable secondary forms on the back and on props, and the idle has a visible breath.
findings.fix: Bake 3-4 deep back folds and a yoke into the normal map, bevel the hook with a lamp notch, and add chest rise and head tilt to the idle.
